rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for putting something down, including laying it flat.

example.english: I lay the book down on the table.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 bun2 syu1 fong3 dai1 hai2 toi4 min6

rows.note: Use this specifically when an animal produces or deposits an egg.

example.english: The hen lay an egg this morning.
example.jyutping: zek3 mou5 gai1 gam1 ziu1 saang1 daan2

rows.note: Use this colloquial euphemism when “have sex with” is meant in an informal context.

example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 cam4 maan5 jat1 cai4 gaau2 je5

rows.note: Use this for laying flat or layered building materials such as flooring or tiles.

example.english: The workers lay floor tiles one by one.
example.jyutping: gung1 jan4 zuk6 faai3 pou1 dei6 zyun1
